changed_behaviour: Annotation responses gain a new errorMessage field on VariantAnnotation objects.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; the response model gains an errorMessage property.

changed_behaviour: Evaluation result segmentID is now set only when a segment yields a variant, not the last evaluated segment.
rationale: No contract documents exist; change alters segmentID value in evaluation responses.

changed_behaviour: Branch updates to branches with a merge queue are no longer rejected as rule violations on API commits or pushes.
rationale: Commit operation documented with generic 422; contract never mentions merge queues or this protection rule.

changed_behaviour: Hook resources created during sync now get app-instance tracking per configured tracking method (annotation/label, truncated label) instead of a plain label.
rationale: Sync operation is described, but nothing specifies how hook resources are labelled or annotated for tracking.

changed_behaviour: Bridge objects accept and return a new websocketConfiguration (enabled, serverPath, subProtocol) field.
rationale: Bridge endpoints are documented but no contract version mentions websocketConfiguration.

changed_behaviour: Video stream playlist and segment endpoints default the channel query parameter to 1 instead of 0 when omitted.
rationale: openapi.yaml exists but has no /stream paths.

changed_behaviour: Report generation accepts path and build values up to 120 characters instead of 20.
rationale: No contract document; Size constraint on request DTO widened.

changed_behaviour: Saved commands returned for a device are now ordered by description.
rationale: Operation documented; contract says nothing about result ordering.

changed_behaviour: Location levels listing gains an include-aliases query parameter and an aliases field in returned levels.
rationale: No checked-in contract; new parameter and response field.

changed_behaviour: Namespaced target resources lacking a namespace now get tracking metadata re-applied; comparison error condition message text changes.
rationale: Change is controller-side; contract describes applications but not target normalization or condition messages.

changed_behaviour: Wallet direct_post endpoint now accepts a JARM 'response' JWT (verified signature) and returns 400 on unparsable form data; default client_id_scheme typo fixed.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; direct_post request handling extended to JWT-secured responses.

changed_behaviour: The Accept request header is no longer echoed back as a response header.
rationale: Listed files are Kubernetes/Helm Swagger UI deployment manifests, not API descriptions; header affects all HTTP operations generically.

changed_behaviour: comment_id query parameter of comment page listing is now decoded from short-ID form before lookup.
rationale: Operation documented with page, page_size, object_id, query_cond only; comment_id and short-ID decoding not mentioned.

changed_behaviour: Deleting a GitHub branch now unpublishes a published workflow left with no versions and updates the search index.
rationale: Description says versions are deleted; nothing about unpublishing workflows that lose all versions.

changed_behaviour: OAuth authorize and OIDC login stubs now return 405 with status failed; /oauth/redirect replaced by /oauth/userinfo; new /oidc/redirect endpoint.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: In strict mode, batch check results with unknown membership now carry the limitation text in the error field instead of empty.
rationale: Error field described only as 'any error generated while checking'; strict mode and limitation reporting are not mentioned.

changed_behaviour: Annotation responses gain a new genomicLocationExplanation field on VariantAnnotation objects.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; new response property added to model.

changed_behaviour: Submodel element mutations are now serialized, so concurrent creates of the same idShort yield a conflict instead of duplicates.
rationale: No contract; change is a concurrency fix only visible under concurrent requests.

changed_behaviour: New subGroupsCount query parameter (default true); children listing now includes subGroupCount even with briefRepresentation=true.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: Connection create/modify now validates response-diversion header mappings and rejects invalid configurations; new diversion headers recognized.
rationale: Only Swagger UI deployment manifests exist; no usable API description.

changed_behaviour: Question page canonical URL omits the title slug when the permalink setting is question-ID-by-short-ID.
rationale: Server-rendered HTML question page is not described in the Swagger documents, which cover /answer/api/v1 JSON endpoints.

changed_behaviour: Gitspace create accepts a new code_repo_ref field and internal repos are resolved by it instead of code_repo_url; actions fail without a ref.
rationale: Create request schema lists code_repo_url etc. but no code_repo_ref; repo resolution rule not stated.

changed_behaviour: Requests with an unknown HTTP method now end with the 405 response, marked handled so no further handler processes them.
rationale: No checked-in contract; change applies to any path requested with an unsupported method.

changed_behaviour: Artifact/version creation records the authenticated principal as owner explicitly; update-via-create paths now enforce artifact write authorization.
rationale: owner field appears untyped/undescribed; no 403 or owner derivation rule documented for these operations.

changed_behaviour: Entra ID sessions with expired access tokens now attempt silent renewal (throttled after failure) and refresh group memberships used for access filtering.
rationale: Internal session token renewal; contract describes search and sessions but not Entra ID token refresh or group re-reading.

changed_behaviour: Kafka operations now run on a bounded executor; when overloaded the bridge returns 503 'Bridge is overloaded, please retry later'.
rationale: Operations documented but no 503 response or overload behaviour appears anywhere in the contract.

changed_behaviour: Multipart file uploads missing the file or fileName part are now rejected with an error.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; new required-part validation on multipart bodies.

changed_behaviour: Validation error messages in error-field responses are now capitalised and end with a period.
rationale: Applies to all validated requests; contract has no error_msg schema or message-format statement.

changed_behaviour: When cancelling runs with reusable-workflow callers, caller jobs take status from their children's aggregation instead of being cancelled directly.
rationale: Cancel operation summary only says it cancels a run and its jobs; caller status aggregation not described.

changed_behaviour: Without a stored rule, config GET returns the configured default global compatibility instead of NONE; setting NONE stores a rule instead of deleting it.
rationale: Config operations described generically; no fallback default or NONE-deletes-rule semantics stated.

changed_behaviour: Internal Altinn access DTO gains an adressesperreTilganger list; no direct HTTP-observable change identified.
rationale: No contract; record appears to model an upstream Altinn response, effect on exposed endpoints not visible.

changed_behaviour: Project PATCH now renames the project using required name and office query parameters instead of updating from the request body.
rationale: swagger-config.yaml exists but lists only locations, timeseries, ratings, levels etc.; no /projects path.

changed_behaviour: Passkey login satisfying two factors now sends only the 2FA response instead of also running the 1FA response handler.
rationale: Operation documented with 200 redirectResponse/403; nothing about two-factor passkey response handling.

changed_behaviour: Project names are trimmed on create/rename and too-short trimmed names rejected with 400; finish notifications skipped for manual launches.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: CORS headers are now granted to origins starting with http://127.0.0.1, like localhost.
rationale: CORS filter applies to all routes; Swagger documents contain no CORS or Origin statements.

changed_behaviour: Policy conditions accept an EXPRESSION subject with CEL validation (400 with celErrors), a violationType field, and values longer than 255 chars.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: Settings key server.footer.links is replaced by server.sidebar.links; the old key is no longer accepted.
rationale: No contract document; enum of accepted setting keys changed in request DTO.

changed_behaviour: Attachment previews are still rendered and returned when the key-value cache read or write fails.
rationale: preview_size documented generally; contract says nothing about cache failure handling. Largely a refactor.

changed_behaviour: Disbursement periods in loan schedules now include fee charges due at disbursement instead of ignoring them.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: Product-not-found for reviews now returns 404 instead of 400; type-mismatch and unreadable-body errors no longer become 500.
spec_quote: Bad request, e.g. the query parameters are invalid or product not found.
rationale: Contract explicitly assigns 400 to product-not-found; code now returns 404.

changed_behaviour: New endpoint serves the per-request JARM ephemeral public JWKS; request objects now reference it by URL instead of the verifier's public key set.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: Password policy failures (too short, too similar to identifier, too many breaches) now yield dedicated validation message IDs/texts.
rationale: Flow operations and generic uiText (id, text, type) are described; specific password-policy message IDs are not listed.

changed_behaviour: Version/source info responses gain an annotationSourcesInfo list with id, name, version, type, description, url.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; new response field on aggregate source info.

changed_behaviour: Permission computation for Entra ID users is synchronized, so parent-group permissions are no longer lost to a race, affecting access-filtered results.
rationale: Internal race fix; contract does not describe group/permission computation for search results.

changed_behaviour: Contract sync skips partner entitlements lacking purchase data (and tolerates missing contracts) instead of failing.
rationale: Sync operations documented with success response only; handling of malformed upstream entitlements not stated.

changed_behaviour: Importing passkey credentials without a user_handle or without credentials is now rejected with 400.
rationale: Passkey import config lists user_handle and credentials but marks neither required; no rejection rule stated.

changed_behaviour: Flag snapshot listing applies a configured default limit when no limit parameter is given.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: Iceberg schemas whose fields use the initial column ID are no longer rejected as duplicate field IDs.
rationale: Only document has paths: {} (inferred from annotations); no Iceberg REST operations described.

changed_behaviour: Deleted or timed-out consumers are deregistered via the endpoint close handler, with inactivity timestamps cleaned up consistently.
rationale: Mostly a concurrency fix; contract does not describe consumer deregistration timing or inactivity timeout.

changed_behaviour: Process update now pre-fills config with current values, so omitted fields keep existing values; unknown IDs return 404 before body parsing.
rationale: Contract states replace semantics; update now merges omitted fields from the current config.

changed_behaviour: Azure AD login migrated to MSAL: user search roles now derive from homeAccountId/username, and token refresh uses silent acquisition, changing permission-filtered results.
rationale: Search operation documented; contract says nothing about Azure AD identity attributes used for role/permission filtering.

changed_behaviour: Page numbers below 1 are clamped to 1 and negative page sizes to 0 instead of being rejected.
rationale: Only OpenAPI generator config files exist; no API description. Affects all paged list endpoints.

changed_behaviour: Listing commits with a non-existent sha now returns 404 instead of 500.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists at the parent commit.

changed_behaviour: Implicit subscriptions are now created even when the user already has an inherited (parent project) subscription.
rationale: Contract documents explicit subscribe/unsubscribe only; implicit subscription on task actions not described.

changed_behaviour: Non-HTTPS return_url on a live account now yields 422 with error code P0920 and a return_url-specific message.
rationale: 422 documented only with a description-length example; request return_url has no HTTPS constraint and P0920 is absent.

changed_behaviour: Async operation bindings gain a routingKey field in service/operation representations.
rationale: Binding schema lists type, keyType, destinationType, destinationName, qoS, persistent; no routingKey.

changed_behaviour: Endpoint descriptors now build href from callback address/server path plus prefix, derive interface names, and add subprotocol fields.
rationale: No contract; descriptors appear to be published to registries rather than served by a specific endpoint.

changed_behaviour: Recent time-series values requested by ts-ids are now filtered by the given office.
rationale: No checked-in contract document exists.

changed_behaviour: Import returns 400 for empty file, 415 for non-JSON content type and 500 on import failure, instead of always 201.
rationale: Contract documents only the 201 response; no error statuses for invalid uploads.

changed_behaviour: Stopping scan-all now marks the execution stopped so no further artifact scans are submitted; errors are returned to the caller.
rationale: Description only 'Stop scanAll job execution'; nothing on halting pending artifact enumeration.
